recipe_fallback.config.title: Recipe QoL
recipe_fallback.config.enabled.desc.2: Turning this off while connected will not remove fallback recipes already shown until you reconnect.
recipe_fallback.config.notification_mode: Controls how the mod reports empty-sync fallback activation.
Notifications are only shown when the server sends an empty recipe sync or empty recipe-book replacement and fallback is actually used.
recipe_fallback.config.verbose_logging.d: Logs additional details when fallback data is loaded, activated, or skipped by config.
recipe_fallback.config.show_ingredient_t: Shows the raw ingredient key before each generated ingredient label in recipe tooltips when available.
Useful for debugging ingredient alias translations.
recipe_fallback.config.fallback_indicato: Adds a tooltip note to recipe-book entries currently coming from fallback data.
recipe_fallback.config.hide_vanilla_reci: Removes the vanilla recipe book button and prevents the book from opening.
Useful if you only want to browse recipes through recipe viewer mods.
recipe_fallback.config.prevent_recipe_bo: Don't shift GUI for recipe book
Keeps supported container screens centered when the vanilla recipe book is open.
The recipe book still works, but it no longer pushes the main GUI sideways.
Note: this can make the GUI extend off-screen if your GUI scale is too large.
recipe_fallback.config.recipes.show_ingr: Adds ingredient lines to recipe-book entry tooltips, including overlay buttons.
recipe_fallback.config.recipes.ungroup.d: Shows each grouped recipe-book display as a separate entry.
recipe_fallback.config.recipe_book.auto_: Closes the recipe book after a recipe inserts ingredients into the menu.
Does not close for ghost recipe previews.
recipe_fallback.config.recipe_book.close: Close recipe book on screen close
Closes the stored recipe-book open state when a supported recipe screen is closed.
recipe_fallback.config.recipe_book.disab: Removes cosmetic bounce and highlight animations from recipe entries and recipe-book tabs.
recipe_fallback.config.recipe_book.show_: Show config button in recipe book
Shows the Recipe QoL settings button inside the vanilla recipe book while it is open.
Hiding it only removes the in-book shortcut. The config screen is still available elsewhere.
Shows an extra recipe-book tab for recipe displays not matched by vanilla resources.
This catches changed vanilla recipes and extra non-vanilla recipes that appear in the book.
Shows the recipe-book tab name when you hover a tab.
recipe_fallback.config.navigation.mouse_: Scroll over the recipe book to move between pages.
recipe_fallback.config.crafting.quick_cr: Ctrl + Left Click: quick-crafts one result from crafting-grid recipe-book entries.
Ctrl + Shift + Left Click: uses vanilla craft-all placement before quick-moving the result slot.
Only crafting-grid recipe-book entries quick-move the result slot. Other recipe books keep vanilla insertion behavior.
Warning: some servers or anti-cheat setups may dislike rapid repeated clicks. Use at your own risk.
recipe_fallback.config.server_override_m: Blacklist disables fallback on listed servers.
Whitelist enables fallback only on listed servers.
Entries are matched case-insensitively against the current server address.
Use hostnames like example.com or host:port. The default port 25565 is matched automatically.
recipe_fallback.config.hide_rei_warning: Hide REI partial recipe data warning
Suppresses REI's partial recipe data warning while empty-sync fallback is active.
recipe_fallback.config.rei_bridge_enable: Keeps REI in sync when Recipe QoL adds or removes fallback and always-visible recipes.
Disable this if REI integration causes issues on your setup.
recipe_fallback.config.jei_bridge_enable: Keeps JEI in sync when Recipe QoL adds or removes fallback and always-visible recipes.
Disable this if JEI integration causes issues on your setup.
recipe_fallback.config.include_modded_re: Allows fallback to use non-vanilla packs in addition to vanilla data.
When known packs are available, this uses the server's selected non-vanilla packs. Otherwise it uses your selected client packs.
Disable this if those extra recipes do not exist on the server you joined.
recipe_fallback.config.force_show_all_re: Shows extra fallback recipe-book entries even if the server has not unlocked them.
Unlike the default empty-sync fallback behavior, this also works on servers that already send recipe data.
Fallback recipes come from server-selected known packs when available, otherwise from local client resources.
If a server changes a recipe but never syncs that change, the client can only show the version available in those fallback resources.
recipe_fallback.config.server_only_show_: Shows recipes from server-selected known packs even if the server has not unlocked them in the recipe book.
This does not fall back to local client resources.
If the server does not provide data from known packs, or the client cannot load them, no extra recipes are shown.
This feature is a lot more niche than it seems and may not work as you expect.
recipe_fallback.toast.title: Recipe QoL
recipe_fallback.tooltip.fallback_recipe: Client-side fallback recipe. Server may differ.
